problem_text:
A logistics company must allocate its fleet of ten specialized delivery vehicles to transport ten distinct categories of cargo. The revenue generated per ton for each cargo type is as follows:
* For Cargo Alpha, revenue is 5.739 per ton
* For Cargo Beta, revenue is 19.113 per ton
* For Cargo Gamma, revenue is 5.465 per ton
* For Cargo Delta, revenue is 9.079 per ton
* For Cargo Epsilon, revenue is 14.89 per ton
* For Cargo Zeta, revenue is 13.591 per ton
* For Cargo Eta, revenue is 15.988 per ton
* For Cargo Theta, revenue is 9.73 per ton
* For Cargo Iota, revenue is 16.286 per ton
* For Cargo Kappa, revenue is 5.829 per ton

The handling duration required per ton for each vehicle type is detailed below:
*For Cargo Alpha, Vehicle 1 consumes 0.26 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 consumes 0.62 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 consumes 1.689 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 consumes 0.402 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 consumes 1.523 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 consumes 1.896 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 consumes 1.948 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 consumes 0.364 (ton-hours), Vehicle 9 consumes 0.661 (ton-hours), Vehicle 10 consumes 0.304 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Beta, Vehicle 1 consumes 1.572 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 consumes 0.962 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 consumes 0.677 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 consumes 1.823 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 consumes 1.264 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 consumes 1.957 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 consumes 1.426 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 consumes 0.399 (ton-hours), Vehicle 9 consumes 0.443 (ton-hours), Vehicle 10 consumes 0.412 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Gamma, Vehicle 1 consumes 0.851 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 consumes 1.619 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 consumes 1.852 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 consumes 0.297 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 consumes 0.936 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 consumes 1.895 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 consumes 1.638 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 consumes 0.704 (ton-hours), Vehicle 9 consumes 1.815 (ton-hours), Vehicle 10 consumes 0.448 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Delta, Vehicle 1 consumes 0.804 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 consumes 0.568 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 consumes 0.964 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 consumes 1.161 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 consumes 0.331 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 consumes 0.517 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 consumes 1.313 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 consumes 1.712 (ton-hours), Vehicle 9 consumes 0.36 (ton-hours), Vehicle 10 consumes 1.922 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Epsilon, Vehicle 1 consumes 1.101 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 consumes 1.595 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 consumes 0.305 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 consumes 0.843 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 consumes 1.031 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 consumes 1.216 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 consumes 1.933 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 consumes 1.11 (ton-hours), Vehicle 9 consumes 1.844 (ton-hours), Vehicle 10 consumes 1.942 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Zeta, Vehicle 1 consumes 1.809 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 consumes 0.833 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 consumes 1.762 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 consumes 0.764 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 consumes 1.494 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 consumes 1.455 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 consumes 1.284 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 consumes 1.82 (ton-hours), Vehicle 9 consumes 1.63 (ton-hours), Vehicle 10 consumes 1.664 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Eta, Vehicle 1 consumes 0.963 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 consumes 1.795 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 consumes 1.512 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 consumes 0.768 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 consumes 0.96 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 consumes 0.63 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 consumes 1.732 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 consumes 0.872 (ton-hours), Vehicle 9 consumes 0.875 (ton-hours), Vehicle 10 consumes 0.898 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Theta, Vehicle 1 consumes 1.207 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 consumes 0.708 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 consumes 1.675 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 consumes 1.405 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 consumes 1.626 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 consumes 0.323 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 consumes 0.878 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 consumes 0.573 (ton-hours), Vehicle 9 consumes 0.548 (ton-hours), Vehicle 10 consumes 0.807 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Iota, Vehicle 1 consumes 1.735 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 consumes 0.88 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 consumes 0.313 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 consumes 1.726 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 consumes 1.616 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 consumes 1.187 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 consumes 0.284 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 consumes 0.475 (ton-hours), Vehicle 9 consumes 0.844 (ton-hours), Vehicle 10 consumes 0.947 (ton-hours)
*For Cargo Kappa, Vehicle 1 consumes 0.74 (ton-hours), Vehicle 2 consumes 1.581 (ton-hours), Vehicle 3 consumes 1.941 (ton-hours), Vehicle 4 consumes 0.97 (ton-hours), Vehicle 5 consumes 0.508 (ton-hours), Vehicle 6 consumes 1.013 (ton-hours), Vehicle 7 consumes 0.448 (ton-hours), Vehicle 8 consumes 1.035 (ton-hours), Vehicle 9 consumes 0.937 (ton-hours), Vehicle 10 consumes 1.968 (ton-hours)

* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 1 must not surpass 148.353
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 2 must not surpass 155.071
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 3 must not surpass 145.461
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 4 must not surpass 153.225
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 5 must not surpass 124.335
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 6 must not surpass 156.142
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 7 must not surpass 140.989
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 8 must not surpass 91.258
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 9 must not surpass 105.061
* The cumulative operational hours for Vehicle 10 must not surpass 135.966

Under the stipulation that for each vehicle type—Vehicle 1, Vehicle 2, Vehicle 3, Vehicle 4, Vehicle 5, Vehicle 6, Vehicle 7, Vehicle 8, Vehicle 9, Vehicle 10—the total handling duration must remain within its respective available hours, determine the optimal tonnage allocation for each cargo category to maximize the aggregate revenue.
